title: Immediate Resuscitation & Life Threats
redFlags: Unresponsive or severe altered mental status
Severe respiratory distress or cyanosis
Anaphylaxis with airway compromise
Profound shock or pulselessness
बेहोशी या सांस लेने में असमर्थता
immediateActions: Zero-wait immediate resuscitation bay transfer
Airway assessment and supplemental high-flow O2
Continuous cardiac telemetry and large-bore IV access
precautionsEn: Emergency team notified immediately. Do not leave the patient unattended. Move to Trauma/Resus Bay.
precautionsHi: आपातकालीन टीम को तुरंत सूचित किया गया है। मरीज को अकेला न छोड़ें। तुरंत ट्रॉमा बे में ले जाएं।

title: Acute Coronary Syndrome & High-Risk Chest Pain
redFlags: Substernal chest pressure or crushing sensation
Radiation to jaw, left arm, neck, or back
Diaphoresis, nausea, dizziness, or cold clammy skin
सीने में तेज दबाव, बाएं हाथ या जबड़े में दर्द
immediateActions: 12-Lead ECG within 10 minutes of arrival
Stat Troponin-I and CK-MB draw
Aspirin 300mg chewable stat if no contraindication
precautionsEn: Sit still and rest. Avoid physical exertion. Do not consume food or hot beverages right now.
precautionsHi: शांति से बैठें और कोई शारीरिक मेहनत न करें। अभी कुछ भी खाएं या पिएं नहीं।

title: Acute Neurological Deficit & Suspected Stroke
redFlags: Sudden unilateral facial droop, arm drift, or weakness (FAST)
Sudden slurred speech or inability to speak (Aphasia)
Sudden loss of vision or severe vertigo with ataxia
मुंह टेढ़ा होना, हाथ में कमजोरी, बोलने में लड़खड़ाहट
immediateActions: Activate Code Stroke protocol
Ascertain exact Last Known Well (LKW) time for thrombolysis window (<4.5 hrs)
Stat non-contrast Head CT / Brain MRI
precautionsEn: Keep the patient seated or elevated at 30 degrees. Give nothing by mouth (strict NPO). Note exact time symptoms began.
precautionsHi: मरीज को 30 डिग्री के कोण पर सीधा बैठाएं। मुंह से कुछ भी खाने-पीने को न दें। लक्षण शुरू होने का सही समय याद रखें।

title: Acute Abdominal Pain & Surgical Abdomen
redFlags: Localized right lower quadrant pain with rebound tenderness
Severe epigastric pain radiating to the back
Persistent bilious or coffee-ground vomiting
Inability to tolerate liquids or high fever
पेट के निचले दाएं हिस्से में तेज दर्द, लगातार उल्टी
immediateActions: Keep patient NPO (Nil Per Os) in case emergency surgery is needed
Establish IV hydration for ongoing emesis
Abdominal ultrasound examination
precautionsEn: Do not eat or drink anything until doctor examination (strict fasting for ultrasound/surgery). Avoid painkillers that mask symptoms.
precautionsHi: डॉक्टर की जांच तक कुछ भी न खाएं-पिएं (अल्ट्रासाउंड के लिए खाली पेट रहना जरूरी है)। पेट दर्द की बिना पर्ची की दवा न लें।

title: Pediatric Febrile Illness & Dehydration
redFlags: Infant under 3 months with fever > 38°C
Lethargy, poor feeding, sunken fontanelle
Non-blanching petechial or purpuric rash
बच्चे को तेज बुखार, सुस्ती, दूध न पीना
immediateActions: Assess hydration status (mucous membranes, skin turgor, wet diapers)
Oral rehydration or gentle antipyresis as ordered by pediatrician
Screen for febrile seizure history
anticipatedOrders: Rapid Dengue / Malaria Serology (in endemic periods)
precautionsEn: Keep the child comfortable and lightly clothed. Offer oral rehydration fluids in small sips. Watch for extreme lethargy.
precautionsHi: बच्चे को हल्के कपड़े पहनाएं। ORS का घोल थोड़े-थोड़े समय पर पिलाएं। तेज सुस्ती आने पर तुरंत बताएं।

title: Acute Musculoskeletal Injury & Extremity Trauma
redFlags: Gross extremity deformity or bone protrusion (Open fracture - escalate to L2)
Absence of distal peripheral pulse or cold limb (Neurovascular compromise)
Severe localized swelling with inability to bear weight
हड्डी टूटना, पैर या हाथ में अत्यधिक सूजन, भार न ले पाना
immediateActions: Temporary splinting and immobilization of the affected limb
Ice pack application and extremity elevation
Targeted multi-view digital radiography
anticipatedOrders: Digital X-Ray (AP and Lateral views of affected joint/bone)
precautionsEn: Do not attempt to put weight on the injured limb. Keep the limb elevated on a pillow and apply ice if available.
precautionsHi: चोट लगे पैर या हाथ पर बिल्कुल भी वजन न डालें। अंग को तकिए पर ऊंचा रखें और बर्फ की सिकाई करें।

title: Routine Consultation & Medication Refills
redFlags: None. Patient is clinically stable with no acute physiological derangements
immediateActions: Direct to General Outpatient consultation queue
Collect past treatment records and medication lists
differentialConsiderations: Mild seasonal coryza / URI without distress
anticipatedOrders: Fasting Blood Sugar / HbA1c (if diabetic follow-up)
precautionsEn: Keep all past prescriptions, discharge summaries, and previous lab reports organized for the doctor.
precautionsHi: डॉक्टर को दिखाने के लिए अपने पुराने पर्चे, दवाइयां और पुरानी जांच रिपोर्ट साथ में तैयार रखें।
